failure_classes.name: Data Integrity Failure
failure_classes.description: Corrupted, truncated, misaligned, or missing rasters, masks, manifests, or labels.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Verify cryptographic SHA256 hashes and physical manifest invariants before reading data.

failure_classes.name: Population Construction Defect
failure_classes.description: Evaluating sample eligibility prior to validity masking, cropping, or nodata filtering.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: GOV-RULE-129: All sample eligibility criteria must be evaluated after all validity transformations.

failure_classes.name: Observation Unit Mismatch
failure_classes.description: Conflating tiles, patches, minibatches, or pixels with physical experimental units.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Explicitly define observation unit (e.g. tile vs scene) in the registered plan and verify in data loader.

failure_classes.name: Inference Unit Mismatch
failure_classes.description: Treating non-independent sub-units (e.g. tiles from the same scene) as independent units of inference.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Aggregate sub-unit observations to parent acquisition cluster medians before inferential testing.

failure_classes.name: False Independence Assumption
failure_classes.description: Assuming independent observations across samples sharing parent scene, geographic cluster, or acquisition pass.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Verify clustering structure and require cluster block bootstrap or paired cluster tests.

failure_classes.name: Taxonomy Drift
failure_classes.description: Modifying or confusing dense class IDs, source labels, or semantic meanings across phases.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Enforce immutable 12-class dense taxonomy dictionary; distinguish source labels from dense indices.

failure_classes.name: Mathematical Definition Drift
failure_classes.description: Altering loss functions, similarity metrics, or statistical estimators from registered specification.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Derive formulas directly from registered protocol and verify with unit tests against reference tensors.

failure_classes.name: Gradient or Loss Denominator Drift
failure_classes.description: Substituting subset-normalized denominators for full-batch denominators in masked gradient computations.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Assert denominator semantics explicitly: masked loss must normalize by total valid pixels or registered weight sum.

failure_classes.name: Implementation Contract Mismatch
failure_classes.description: Discrepancy between mathematical/scientific specification and actual runtime code execution.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Pre-execution contract testing: verify code behavior directly against mathematical test vectors.

failure_classes.name: Model State Mismatch
failure_classes.description: Running diagnostics in model.train() mode, causing BatchNorm buffer mutation or dropout randomness.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Explicitly enforce model.eval() and assert running mean/var buffers remain identical before and after diagnostic.

failure_classes.name: Autograd Semantics Error
failure_classes.description: Graph retention, in-place tensor mutations, or incorrect backward pass accumulation.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Verify autograd graph lifecycle and assert gradient zeroing between distinct observational backward passes.

failure_classes.name: Optimization Semantics Error
failure_classes.description: Optimizer step, learning rate schedule, or weight decay invocation during diagnostic profiling.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: BLOCK-006: Diagnostic governance counters assert optimizer_steps == 0, parameter_updates == 0.

failure_classes.name: Statistical Provenance Mismatch
failure_classes.description: Discrepancy between executed statistical routine and documented distribution or metadata.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: GOV-RULE-130: Explicitly bind method arguments in code and derive artifact metadata directly from the call.

failure_classes.name: Statistical Inference Defect
failure_classes.description: Applying inappropriate parametric tests, unadjusted multiple testing, or invalid null distributions.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Require non-parametric rank tests (Wilcoxon) or cluster bootstrap with verified exchangeability.

failure_classes.name: P-Value Overinterpretation
failure_classes.description: Interpreting p > 0.05 as proof of zero effect or absence of difference.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: GOV-RULE-131: Non-significant tests report 'did not detect a statistically distinguishable difference under registered design'.

failure_classes.name: Causal Overclaim from Observational Evidence
failure_classes.description: Using causal verbs (drives, causes, explains, bottleneck) on purely observational or descriptive data.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: BLOCK-004 / FP-016: Calibrate language to 'observed', 'associated with', or 'HYPOTHESIZED'.

failure_classes.name: Static-vs-Dynamic Conflation
failure_classes.description: Extrapolating multi-step training dynamics or optimization stability from static Step-0 evaluations.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Explicitly state that Step-0 profiling characterizes initialization geometry only, not dynamic trajectory.

failure_classes.name: Artifact Integrity & Immutability Violation
failure_classes.description: Mutating historical closed execution artifacts in place or corrupting machine JSON hashes.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Historical machine JSON artifacts are strictly immutable; corrections must produce new versioned artifacts.

failure_classes.name: Artifact-to-Report Inconsistency
failure_classes.description: Discrepancy between quantitative values in machine JSON and numbers cited in markdown narrative.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: GOV-RULE-100: All quantitative assertions in reports must be machine-derived directly from verified JSON.

failure_classes.name: Operational Execution Safety Breach
failure_classes.description: Attempting destructive git operations, GPU allocations, or unconstrained execution loops.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Enforce fail-closed preflight checks and assert working-tree preservation.

failure_classes.name: Task Authorization Scope Breach
failure_classes.description: Executing tasks, training phases, or experiments exceeding explicit user-authorized scope.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Fail-closed task gating: Tier-2/H3 remains blocked until explicit separate authorization.

failure_classes.name: Telemetry Inconsistency or Drift
failure_classes.description: Leaving execution_authorized=true in analysis tasks or reporting incomplete tests at task close.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: BLOCK-012: Preflight verifies telemetry run state matches task constraints before permitting completion.

failure_classes.name: Pixel or Sub-Tile Pseudo-Replication
failure_classes.description: Treating spatially autocorrelated pixel counts (N > 10^6) as independent degrees of freedom.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: BLOCK-009 / FP-010: Require parent acquisition cluster blocking for all inferential uncertainty estimation.

failure_classes.name: Post-Hoc Subgrouping Conflated with Registration
failure_classes.description: Presenting post-hoc subgroup discoveries as if they were preregistered confirmatory hypotheses.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Explicitly label exploratory post-hoc subgroupings and require separate preregistered validation.

failure_classes.name: Non-Deterministic or Unseeded Execution
failure_classes.description: Unseeded random generators, non-deterministic CUDA algorithms, or unversioned dependency drift.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: Fix random seeds, freeze environments, and assert determinism on test subsets.

failure_classes.name: Deprecated or Inaccurate Terminology
failure_classes.description: Using forbidden synonyms (calling OF an 'oil spill', or HM a 'vessel' or 'Heavy Metal').
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: BLOCK-008: Automated regex scan verifies nomenclature matches canonical dictionary.

failure_classes.name: Documentation and Reporting Integrity
failure_classes.description: Inaccurate narrative claims, markdown transcription discrepancies, or outdated documentation.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: GOV-RULE-100: All quantitative assertions in reports must be machine-derived directly from verified JSON.

failure_classes.name: Governance Framework Defect
failure_classes.description: Preflight bypass, unverified PROVEN_STABLE claims, or weakening rules to force test passing.
failure_classes.prevention_guideline: BLOCK-010 / BLOCK-011: Enforce preflight receipts and evidence-based promotion.
